options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: failover_mode
options.description: The failover/load-balancing mode used between the two LDAP servers.

options.name: server1_access_attr_used_for_allow
options.displayName: Server1 Access Attr Used For Allow
options.description: Whether the access attribute is used to allow (Server 1).

options.name: server1_access_attribute
options.description: The LDAP access attribute used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_base_dn
options.description: The base DN used when searching Server 1.

options.name: server1_base_filter
options.description: The base LDAP filter used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_compare_check_items
options.description: Whether Server 1 should compare check items.

options.name: server1_default_profile
options.description: The default profile DN used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_do_xlat
options.description: Whether Server 1 should perform attribute translation (xlat).

options.name: server1_enable_authenticate
options.description: Enables LDAP authentication support for Server 1.

options.name: server1_enable_authorize
options.description: Enables LDAP authorization support for Server 1.

options.name: server1_enable_starttls
options.description: Use STARTTLS when establishing a TLS-protected connection to Server 1.

options.name: server1_enable_tls_support
options.description: Enables TLS support when connecting to Server 1.

options.name: server1_filter
options.description: The LDAP search filter used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_group_enable
options.description: Enables LDAP group membership lookups for Server 1.

options.name: server1_group_membership_attribute
options.description: The LDAP group membership attribute used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_group_membership_filter
options.description: The LDAP group membership filter used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_groupname_attribute
options.description: The LDAP group name attribute used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_identity
options.description: The bind DN used to connect to Server 1.

options.name: server1_keepalive_idle
options.description: The TCP KeepAlive idle interval (in seconds) used with Server 1.

options.name: server1_keepalive_interval
options.description: The TCP KeepAlive interval (in seconds) used with Server 1.

options.name: server1_keepalive_probes
options.description: The number of TCP KeepAlive probes used with Server 1.

options.name: server1_ldap_connections_number
options.description: The maximum number of LDAP connections opened to Server 1.

options.name: server1_misc_enable
options.description: Enables the miscellaneous (Default Profile / Profile Attribute / Access Attribute) block for Server 1.

options.name: server1_msad_compatibility_enable
options.description: Enables Microsoft Active Directory compatibility mode for Server 1.

options.name: server1_net_timeout
options.description: The TCP network timeout (in seconds) used with Server 1.

options.name: server1_password
options.description: The password used to bind to Server 1.

options.name: server1_profile_attribute
options.description: The LDAP profile attribute used by Server 1.

options.name: server1_require_cert
options.description: The certificate verification mode used when connecting to Server 1 with TLS support.

options.name: server1_server
options.description: The FQDN or IP address of Server 1.

options.name: server1_server_port
options.description: The TCP port used to connect to Server 1. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: server1_ssl_ca_cert
options.description: The Certificate Authority (refid) used to verify the Server 1 server certificate when TLS support is enabled.

options.name: server1_ssl_server_cert
options.description: The client Certificate (refid) presented when establishing a TLS connection to Server 1.

options.name: server1_time_limit
options.description: The LDAP search time limit (in seconds) used with Server 1.

options.name: server1_timeout
options.description: The bind/operation timeout (in seconds) used with Server 1.
